title: Rocky Mountain Adventure coming up in IA
content: What I like aboutInternational Artist Magazineis that most the articles are written by the artists themselves.Coming up in the next issue (#112 Dec/Jan) are some insights fromRicky Mujica,Julio Reyes,Rob Piercy, andTanvi Pathare.My article is a chronicle of our recent Rocky Mountain Adventure. The article includes six QR codes that take you to free behind-the-scenes videos. In case your phone or iPad doesn't have the app for reading those QR codes, you can get one free fromQrafterorAndroid's QR Code Reader.
